post.summary: Returns all tenants of a user
post.description:
A KLARA user might have multiple tenants. Use this endpoint to get the list of tenants containing tenant id, company id.
The tenant and company id returned by this endpoint can be used to generate tokens to access other endpoints. Use your KLARA username and password OR access-token to get the list of tenants.

401.description: Invalid credentials

500.description: Something went wrong when getting list of tenants

post.summary: Generate tokens to access other KLARA core endpoints
post.description:
After obtaining tenant id and company id for the desired tenant, use this endpoint to get the access token for a specific tenant, and refresh token.
A grant_type of password is used for a Password grant, which requires username, password, tenant and company id to produce access token, refresh token from scratch.
A grant_type of refresh_token is used for a Refresh token grant, which is used for acquiring the access token using refresh token.
A grant_type of token_exchange performs an OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693). Provide subject_token (the raw upstream Bearer token, without the 'Bearer ' prefix) and audience to identify the target token type.
Supported audience values:
  • cossa — exchanges a COSSA bearer token for a ePost access token.
Note: subject_token must be the raw token value without the 'Bearer ' prefix.

post.description:
Generate a link or QR code on which interacted/scanned, the actions defined in the request body will be executed.
The response output is decided by the Accept header of the request
If a value of "text/html" is entered in the Accept header, a response with "text/html" media type is returned containing the URL.
If a value of "image/png" is entered in the Accept header, a response with "image/png" media type is returned containing the QR code.
Verification score of the credentials Accept value 0 or 50.
Only one credential has verification score in the request body.

allOf.description:
Specifies the tier for the delivery via channel DIGITAL. This selection determines the availability of digital receipts, tracking capabilities, and recipient identification requirements. If digitalDeliveryVariant is omitted, the system defaults to 'STANDARD'.

STANDARD: Standard digital delivery with proof of dispatch. Includes a digital timestamp and signature upon acceptance by ePost. [ePost Standard]
NO_CONFIRMATION: Basic digital delivery. Provides a digital delivery without additional digital receipts or tracking features. [ePost Light]
TRACKED: Enhanced delivery with retrieval tracking. Includes all features of STANDARD, plus 'Retrieval' and 'Non-retrieval' receipts to track if and when the recipient opened the message. [ePost Plus]
REGISTERED: Full legal-grade digital registered mail. Includes all TRACKED features, as well as recipient acceptance/rejection tracking and mandatory Person Identification. Important note: 'minimumLevelOfTrust' must be set to GOLD for the recipient, as verification of the recipient as a person by an online identification process is prerequisite for ePost Registered. [ePost Registered]

letterAnswer.description: Specifies an optional recipient response option for the delivery via channel DIGITAL. When set to a supported value, the recipient is offered a corresponding action on the delivered document in the digital letterbox. This field is only considered for the DIGITAL channel; it is ignored for all other channels. Supported values are provisioned per agreement with ePost. If omitted, empty, or set to an unrecognised value, no response option is offered and the delivery proceeds normally.

allCredentialShouldMatch.description:
Decides if this document should be delivered to ONLY the recipients that have their credentials all matched or not.
If not specified, then default value of TRUE is used.
This flag is only considered for the DIGITAL delivery in ePost.

mediaType.description:
Indicate the specific media type of the document. For sending a standard classic letter like a PDF leave this field empty.
Acceptable values:
"application/vnd.ch.klara.epost.smartletter.v1+json" for smart letter. Indicate that if this document file is a smart letter.
"application/vnd.ch.klara.epost.v1+simple_short_message" for simple short message. To send simple short message, leave the document type empty.
"application/vnd.ch.klara.epost.v1+incamail" Please use SecureSend instead of IncaMail.
"application/vnd.ch.klara.epost.v1+securesend" for SecureSend.
null for Physical delivery.

deliveryChannelPreferences.description:
This value defines your preference & priority among delivery channels. It defines that your letter/message/document should be delivered via which one of the available channels. You can input more than one delivery channel.

The order of delivery channels defines the priority of each channel. Meaning, at first we try to deliver via the first mentioned delivery channel, if it's unsuccessful, we would try via the second channel mentioned, and so on.

If delivery is not successful via any of the delivery methods, then an error response will be returned to the sender.

DIGITAL delivering it to the recipient's ePost letterbox (available for all types of documents/letters/messages)
PHYSICAL printing and sending the letter physically (only specific pdf formats are accepted)
SMS delivering the "simple short message" as a SMS to the recipient's mobile phone. (only for simple short message media type)
EBILL delivering it to the recipient's eBill (available for invoice document type with pdf format)
EMAIL delivering it to the recipient who using email
AUTO will try to find most suitable one from all available channel in order like this (DIGITAL, SMS, EBILL, PHYSICAL, EMAIL) then do the delivering

senderName.description: This value will be shown to the recipient as the delivery sender name.

senderEndToEndId.description: This id provided by the sender. It helps the sender to reference the document during the whole process.

senderCaseId.description: This id provided by the sender. If multiple Documents are related to one case (e.g. insurance) it helps the receiver to group received documents

documentReferenceDate.description:
This date is relevant for a document from a business point of view, it differs from the date at which the document is entered in the "KLARA Documents" system.

allOf.description: Singature's info if document required Singature.

This object is optional. Defines whether all recipients of this document should be forced to register to ePost in order to receive this document. If the recipient is already registered to ePost, the normal delivery flow applies. If the recipient is not yet registered to ePost, we will send him an email asking him to register to ePost in order to receive the document. The document is stored for up to 60 days and will be delivered to the recipient as soon as he registers to ePost. After 60 days the delivery will expire.
Reminder emails are sent to the recipient after 2, 25, 40 and 55 days.
Forced onboarding is only available for the delivery channel DIGITAL. Additionally the unhashed credential EMAIL is required for forced onboarding (onboarding request email will be sent to this email address) and the minimum level of trust must be BRONZE. (It is only supported in the async deliveries API.)

PHYSICAL printing and sending the letter physically (only specific pdf formats are accepted)
SMS delivering the "simple short message" as a SMS to the recipient's mobile phone. (only for simple short message media type)
EBILL delivering it to the recipient's eBill (available for invoice document type with pdf format)
EMAIL delivering it to the recipient who using email
AUTO will try to find most suitable one from all available channel in order like this (DIGITAL, SMS, EBILL, PHYSICAL, EMAIL) then do the delivering

This object is optional. Defines whether all recipients of this document should be forced to register to ePost in order to receive this document. If the recipient is already registered to ePost, the normal delivery flow applies. If the recipient is not yet registered to ePost, we will send him an email asking him to register to ePost in order to receive the document. The document is stored for up to 60 days and will be delivered to the recipient as soon as he registers to ePost. After 60 days the delivery will expire.
Reminder emails are sent to the recipient after 2, 25, 40 and 55 days.
Forced onboarding is only available for the delivery channel DIGITAL. Additionally the unhashed credential EMAIL is required for forced onboarding (onboarding request email will be sent to this email address) and the minimum level of trust must be BRONZE. (It is only supported in the async deliveries API.)
